200 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully created the OT connector.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
string
The unique ID of your Tenable Vulnerability Management instance.
string
The unique ID of the OT connector.
string
The OT connectors name.
string
The sensor type. This value is always ot  for OT connectors.
string
The OT connector's type. There are two types of OT connectors,
Industrial Core Platform (ICP) and Enterprise Manager (EM).
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was created.
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was last modified.
integer <int64>
The Unix timestamp of when the OT connector was last authenticated.
boolean
Indicates whether or not the OT connector is enabled.
string
The credential used for authentication when the OT connector connects
to Tenable Vulnerability Management.
enabled

— 400 Returned if the provided linking key does not match existing records or is expired.
500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an error while attempting to create the OT
connector.
RESPONSE SCHEMA:
application/json
integer
The HTTP status code.
string
The HTTP status text.
string
A brief message describing the error Tenable Vulnerability Management
encountered.
